# CANDIDATE: BASELINE_ENGINE_STAGE1_VALIDATION

**Filed:** 2026-07-21
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** quality_gate
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The current engine's edge_capture on J anchor days is sufficient to pass the OP-16 floor (>=771) and we aim to validate its robustness via walk-forward OOS and real-fills on the top 3 J days.

## Mechanism

No changes to the engine. We will run a Stage-1 backtest on the entire available history to compute the baseline edge_capture on the J anchor days. Then, we will conduct a walk-forward OOS test (using a held-out window) to ensure edge_capture >=771 OOS. Finally, we will validate real-fills on the top 3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) to ensure the simulator matches real OPRA fills within ±20%.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** $25K+ account required for full qty as per engine's current position sizing (to be confirmed in Stage-1 backtest); $1K paper account realizes ~14% of headline P&L.
2. **Sample bias:** Sample size and selection method to be determined in Stage-1 backtest (entire available history). High overfit risk in Stage-1 (in-sample) necessitates walk-forward OOS validation.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window to be conducted after Stage-1).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (validation on top 3 J days to be conducted after Stage-1).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day (max loss on a single J day), max drawdown during test period, blow-up scenario (consecutive losses exceeding daily loss limit).
6. **Concentration:** To be computed after Stage-1 backtest (top-5 days as % of P&L).

## Pre-merge gate

<what tests need to pass: gym validators, walk-forward, real-fills>
Specifically: 
- All gym validators must pass.
- Walk-forward OOS test must show edge_capture >= 771.
- Real-fills validation on top 3 J days must show simulator vs real OPRA fill difference within ±20% for each of the top 3 J days.
